Design principles: - Intentionally mirrors current behavior (v1) - NOT a redesign - Additive only: new features in v1.x as additional functions - Breaking changes will bump to v2.0 and require migration - Future disputes/resolution semantics may be split into separate interfaces - No claims of standardization until post-feedback from integrators + Magicians consensusImplementers should executePendingSettlement(uint256).details: Requires escrow to be in RESOLVED state

getActionStatus(uint256).details: Bitmask bits (append-only in future versions):   bit 0: can call release()   bit 1: can call senderCancel()   bit 2: can call recipientCancel()   bit 3: can call raiseDispute()   bit 4: can call withdrawEscrow() (claimable fallback)Caller should check caller's role (sender/recipient/resolver)Returns actions that MAY succeed; authorization still enforced

returns.actionMask: Bitmask of available actions (see note below)
returns.nextUpdateTime: When this status may change (0 = no timed changes)

getActiveDisputeHandler(uint256).details: Returns address(0) if escrow is not in DISPUTED state

returns.handler: Address of the resolver/module handling the dispute, or address(0) if not disputed

getClaimableBalance(uint256,address).details: Used by wallets to show "You have X to withdraw"

returns.claimable: Amount available to withdraw via withdrawEscrow()

returns.token: Token address (or address(this) for ERC20 escrow)

returns.state: Current EscrowState (NONE, PENDING, RELEASED, REFUNDED, DISPUTED, RESOLVED)

getResolutionMode(uint256).details: Critical for integrators: determines who can resolve disputes

raiseDispute(uint256).details: Moves escrow from PENDING -> DISPUTEDCaller must be participant (sender or recipient)

release(uint256).details: Transitions PENDING → RELEASEDMay transfer funds immediately (push) or make claimable (fallback)Only callable by sender (buyer) when escrow is PENDINGPart of IEscrowCore interface for wallet adoption

withdrawEscrow(uint256).details: Used when release() could not push funds immediatelyRequires escrow to be RELEASED, REFUNDED, or RESOLVED

canRelease(uint256,address).notice: Check if a release is allowed for the given escrow and caller

getActionStatus(uint256).notice: Get wallet-friendly action status for an escrow

getActiveDisputeHandler(uint256).notice: Query the active dispute handler for a workflow

getClaimableBalance(uint256,address).notice: Get claimable balance for a recipient (if push settlement failed)

getEscrowCount().notice: Total number of escrow transfers created in this contract

getEscrowData(uint256).notice: Get escrow data for wallet rendering (without needing logs)

getEscrowState(uint256).notice: Query the current state of an escrow workflow

getResolutionMode(uint256).notice: Query resolution mode for an escrow (direct vs module-based)

raiseDispute(uint256).notice: Raise a dispute on a pending escrow

senderCancel(uint256).notice: Sender cancels pending escrow and recovers funds

withdrawEscrow(uint256).notice: Withdraw claimable funds (fallback when push transfer failed)
